intro: The PCIU website, admin dashboard and faculty portal are designed, built and maintained in-house at Port City International University.

developers.name: Saiyed Mohammad Imtiaj
developers.about: Works on the admin dashboard and its API integration.
contributions: Admin dashboard layout, sidebar and shell
Entity schemas and add/edit pages for every admin section
API service layer with entity management and field aliasing
Faculty portal: live profile form and section management
Bachelor and master admission application forms
Rich text editor and popup management
Role permissions matrix

developers.name: Sajmul Hossain
developers.about: Works on the departments, faculties and academics pages.
contributions: Department pages: overview, programs, teachers, events and sticky navigation
Dynamic faculty detail pages with sidebar navigation
Individual teacher profile pages
Dynamic faculty and department menus in the navbar
Academic sub-pages and exam routine filtering
Sign-in with server actions and cookie handling

developers.name: Shuvo Dev Nath
developers.about: Works on the admission pages, homepage and news.
contributions: Admission pages and admission advertisement
Homepage hero, stats and campus life sections
Faculties page and faculty cards
Contacts page
Notices and events from the API
Site popup, page banner and footer

developers.name: Abu Bin Naser
developers.about: Works on the academics, research and IQAC pages.
contributions: Class and exam routines: admin bulk upload, public pages and faculty portal
Check Free Rooms feature
Dynamic About and Management pages with admin forms
Dynamic IQAC page with activities and gallery admin
Dynamic research pages and research/IQAC redesign
Mobile layout fixes
